note: Scripture is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Japanese, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-ja-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-ja). The edition was first translated quoting the 口語訳 (japkougo); every quotation was re-quoted to OWB per the founder decision that Japanese quotes OWB for every work (2026-11-19).

A `mined` row is a quotation (or verbatim recitation) whose every piece, pieces joined by '……' allowed, is a verbatim span of the cited OWB verse(s). A `self_rendered` row with a `why` is a quotation OWB cannot serve; the rest are the original translator's allusion rows, unchanged. block_index counts the sermon's blocks (the opening blockquote is 0).

Wesley's closing 'he that is born of God doth not commit sin … he sinneth not' is the point the whole section argues; OWB's 犯し続ける would undercut it
